fields.label: Workspace Name
fields.description: The name of this Suite workspace, shown in the launcher and wherever a connected service names this site.

fields.label: Workspace Logo
fields.description: Square image shown beside the workspace name. It is served publicly, so use PNG, JPEG or WebP without anything private.

fields.label: Contact Email
fields.description: Where connected services send notices about this workspace, such as planned downtime or quota warnings.

fields.label: Suite Cloud URL
fields.description: Suite Cloud that manages this site's mail domains, accounts, groups and lists, e.g. https://cloud.frappemail.com. Frappe Cloud writes it into the site config; set it here to override.

fields.label: Site API Key
fields.description: This site's key at Suite Cloud, issued when Frappe Cloud registered the site.

fields.label: Site API Secret
fields.description: This site's secret at Suite Cloud, shown once by Frappe Cloud. Rotate it from Frappe Cloud if it leaks.

fields.label: Onboarded
fields.description: Set once the setup wizard has been completed. While unchecked, the wizard is offered to the first admin who signs in.
